messages.subject: Net-Zero Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Zero Carbon Associates Team,

Your global focus on talent supporting the net-zero transition makes this a relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibility across ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder coordination.

I am internationally mobile and open to Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where sustainability, energy transition, stakeholder strategy and responsible development converge.

My current executive CV is attached for consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
